headlines.desc: The Heat have bounced back from a rough start to the season, while Victor Wembanyama is now the leader for MVP just ahead of Luka Doncic.

headlines.desc: Giannis faces off against his former team as the Heat transform Miami into "Vice City" for Grand Theft Auto VI.

headlines.title: Miami Heat players receive GTA VI care packages from Rockstar Games
headlines.desc: Heat players received a custom game-themed care package complete with custom controllers, consoles and, of course, a copy of the game.

headlines.title: Los Angeles plays San Antonio, looks to end road slide
headlines.desc: Los Angeles Clippers (4-9, 13th in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (12-3, second in the Western Conference)

headlines.title: Los Angeles faces Utah after Grimes' 47-point game
headlines.desc: Utah Jazz (1-13, 14th in the Western Conference) vs. Los Angeles Lakers (13-2, first in the Western Conference)

headlines.title: Quentin Grimes scores 47, forces OT with 10th 3-pointer as Lakers rally past Hornets 118-114
headlines.desc: — Quentin Grimes scored a career-high 47 points and forced overtime on his 10th 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds left in regulation before the Los Angeles Lakers finished off their ninth consecutive victory, 118-114 over the Charlotte Hornets on Tuesday night.

headlines.title: Washington takes on Toronto on 8-game skid
headlines.desc: Washington Wizards (4-11, 12th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Toronto Raptors (5-9, ninth in the Eastern Conference)

headlines.title: Williamson, Pelicans to host Cunningham and the Pistons
headlines.desc: Detroit Pistons (9-4, third in the Eastern Conference) vs. New Orleans Pelicans (5-10, 12th in the Western Conference)

headlines.title: Minnesota plays New York in non-conference action
headlines.desc: New York Knicks (8-6, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (11-4, third in the Western Conference)

headlines.title: Brice Sensabaugh scores 40 points and leads huge 4th quarter as Jazz beat Clippers for 2nd win
headlines.desc: — Brice Sensabaugh scored a season-high 40 points, including 25 in the fourth quarter, and the Utah Jazz beat the Los Angeles Clippers 132-107 on Tuesday night for just their second victory of the season.

headlines.title: McDaniels scores with 2.6 seconds left to lift Timberwolves to 106-105 win over Trail Blazers
headlines.desc: — Jaden McDaniels hit a go-ahead layup with 2.6 seconds remaining after Minnesota stole a Portland inbounds pass and the Timberwolves rallied to beat the Trail Blazers 106-105...

headlines.title: Cunningham, Jenkins lead surge as Pistons snap Spurs' 12-game winning streak with 105-93 victory
headlines.desc: — Cade Cunningham scored 27 points, Daniss Jenkins had 21 of his 25 in the second half and the Detroit Pistons snapped San Antonio's 12-game winning streak, toppling the Spurs 105-93 on Tuesday night.

headlines.title: Jalen Brunson converts tiebreaking 4-point play, scores 31 as Knicks win 15th straight over Raptors
headlines.desc: — Jalen Brunson converted a tiebreaking four-point play with 1:25 left in the fourth quarter, Karl-Anthony Towns had 16 points and 16 rebounds and the New York Knicks beat Toronto 111-102 on Tuesday night, their 15th consecutive win over the Raptors.
